title: Three Years and One Short Seal
subtitle: 责任担当 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 责任担当（人与自我·做人与做事·责任与担当）
meta: 主题语境：责任担当（人与自我·做人与做事·责任与担当）　|　核心词汇：guarantee　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 guarantee 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1978 the engineer ① gave a guarantee that no client in the office would have described, and he said the giving was the whole of the year. The ② guarantee, meaning the promise itself and not the paper, ran three years and stayed undescribed in the book; a guarantee, he said, is the only thing in an office that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ guarantee in that office had the same short seal beside it, and the ④ guarantee at the far drawer, meaning the one they kept for the children to copy and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A guarantee, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the engineer said the describing is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the guarantee was the whole of the matter, meaning the safety and not the promise. The ⑥ guarantee, meaning the safety and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; guarantee, he said, is either something you give or the only word that means both a promise and a safety. He said the safety is the part they remember.

By 1983 the ⑦ guarantee had become a line in a contract, and the contract had become an argument about the short seal. The ⑧ guarantee of the whole thing, the engineer wrote in November, was one office and three years of describing; guarantee, he said, is either the one at the far drawer or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ guarantee I remember is the one described in the contract, which closed in 1985 and is still described as the quietest in the office. A ⑩ guarantee, my mother said in 1987, is the only one that improves by being described; every guarantee, she said, is a safety that has agreed to look like a promise. She said the safety was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 保证；担保（指办公室里每一份旁边的那一份）
B. n. 保证；担保（指那份承诺本身，与纸张相对）
C. 固定搭配：give a guarantee 作出一项保证
D. n. 保证（指留给孩子们学着写的那一份）
E. n. 担保（抽象总称，指一间办公室的担保之事）
F. n. 保证（指合同里写到、被记下的那一份）
G. n. 保修单；保证金（指一件事里人人都收却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 保障（抽象总称，指人人都收却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: gave a guarantee that no client in the office would have described
The guarantee, meaning the promise itself and not the paper
the guarantee at the far drawer
the guarantee was the whole of the matter
the guarantee had become a line in a contract
The guarantee of the whole thing
A guarantee, my mother said in 1987

answers.why: give a guarantee 意为“作出一项保证”，1978 年那位工程师作出了办公室里没有一位客户肯描述的一项保证。
guarantee 意为“保证、担保”，指那份承诺本身而不是纸张，它经过了三年而在簿子上没有被描述。
guarantee 意为“保证、担保”，指办公室里每一份旁边的那一份，每一份旁边都有同一枚矮矮的印章。
guarantee 意为“保证”，指最远那个抽屉里留给孩子们学着写的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
guarantee 意为“保修单、保证金”，指一件事里人人都收却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份保障就是那件事的全部。
guarantee 意为“保障”，指人人都收却无人提起的那样东西而不是那份保证，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
guarantee 意为“保证”，指合同里写到、被记下的那一份，到 1983 年这一份成了合同里的一行。
guarantee 意为“担保”，工程师十一月写道，整件事的担保之事是一间办公室和三年的描述。
guarantee 意为“保证”，我记得的是合同里描述过的那一份，1985 年到期了，至今仍被说成办公室里最安静的一份。
guarantee 为抽象总称，母亲 1987 年说，保证是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的承诺。
